fields: India enters emergency/panic purchasing on Gulf supply loss (49% nitrogen from Gulf)

CONFIRMED at scale on the predicted mechanism. IPL emergency tender Apr 2026: 2.5 Mt in a single tender, ~1/4 of annual import requirement, awarded $935/mt CFR west (1.5 Mt) / $959/mt CFR east (1.0 Mt), ~2x the rate of two months earlier

The March desk's single best call and the highest-value one: it named the mechanism, the geography and the trigger, and all three landed. Retained as the model for how a FERT prediction should be written.
